About.title: About
About.intro: INDX puts every state, union territory and district of India on one map, with the numbers behind each of them.
About.why1: I've loved maps since I was a kid, and all the little facts that come with them. I could never find one place that showed it all together, so I built it.
About.why2: It's also a thank-you to Wikipedia, which got me through countless late-night deep dives and genuinely helped me keep my ADHD in check.
About.dataIntro: India hasn't had a census since 2011, so population figures are official 2026 projections. Where newer numbers don't exist, the latest available source is used.

sources.rgi: State population and sex ratio for 2026
sources.iips: District population and sex ratio for 2026, mapped to today's districts using 2011 census shares
sources.census: District literacy rates and areas, the latest available at district level
sources.gsdp: GSDP at current prices, FY 2024-25 where available
sources.wikipedia: 2011 census figures on current district boundaries and compiled GSDP tables
sources.names: District and city names in Indian languages

About.openDataIntro: Everything on INDX is free to use. Download it as CSV or read it from the JSON API below, and credit INDX and the original sources when you publish it.
